title: Les Enfants jouent à la Russie
text: Les Enfants jouent à la Russie (English: The Kids Play Russian) is a 1993 French film directed by Jean-Luc Godard and starring László Szabó and Godard. Szabó plays a Hollywood producer who hires a famous French filmmaker (Godard) to make a documentary about post-Cold War Russia. Instead, the filmmaker stays in France and casts himself in the lead role of Fyodor Dostoyevsky's The Idiot.
